chars.SAAD: a Moroccan young man about 25, short black curly hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white stripe on the sleeves and black jeans
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman about 24, wearing a pastel pink hijab, a long cream cardigan over a dusty-rose dress
chars.AYOUB: a Moroccan young man about 25, shaved head, wearing a green tracksuit jacket with white zip and grey joggers
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother about 55, wearing a deep burgundy embroidered caftan and a light beige headscarf, warm round face

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan neighbourhood laundry shop with washing machines behind him: SAAD stands at the counter, caught mid-act grinning hugely as he stares at his phone screen showing a photo of a beautiful decorated birthday cake, seen from the shop doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SAAD sits on a stool in the laundry shop typing quickly on his phone with both thumbs, excited and slightly nervous smile, washing machines in the background, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan pastry shop full of cakes in a glass display, GIRL holds her phone and reads a message, eyebrows raised in surprise, a curious half-smile, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in her pastry shop types a reply on her phone with a teasing suspicious look, one eyebrow raised, hand on hip, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Evening at the front door of a Moroccan family house: GIRL arrives dressed elegantly, holding a white cake box with both hands; SAAD opens the door frozen with a shy amazed smile while AYOUB behind him grins and nudges him with his elbow, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan salon decorated for a birthday with gold balloons, a 'happy birthday' garland without letters, traditional sedari sofas and zellige; SAAD proudly guides GIRL inside, she looks around impressed, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the decorated Moroccan salon, MOM stands next to a big low table full of food, tea glasses and pastries, looking at GIRL with a knowing, amused smile as if she understood everything, GIRL smiles back shyly, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SAAD presents GIRL to MOM with an open hand while GIRL hands the beautiful birthday cake to MOM, MOM delighted with hands on her cheeks, warm living room light, 2D animated cartoon style

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A joyful Moroccan family birthday party in the salon: GIRL laughs and claps with two teenage sisters in colourful outfits, SAAD and AYOUB dance and laugh in the background, balloons, everyone happy, 2D animated cartoon style
